question: Kiran spends 65% of his income. If he saves ₹42,000, then his income (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total income of Kiran be 100%.

Percentage of savings = Total Income − Expenditure = 100% − 65% = 35%

Given, 35% → ₹42,000

⇒ 1% → 42,000 ÷ 35 = 1200

⇒ 100% → 1200 × 100 = 1,20,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,20,000.**
